parse.title: A Kingdom Divided/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===The Disgraced Councillor's Escape===
{{Needed|Melee gear, food and potions, 1 free inventory space
|recommended=[[Xeric's talisman]], [[Kharedst's memoirs]], [[Arceuus Library Teleport]], [[Kourend Castle Teleport]]}}

{{Checklist|
* Go speak to [[Martin Holt]] east of the [[Kourend Castle]] and start the quest. {{Chat option|1 Yes.}}
* Go to the ground floor of the Kourend Castle and speak to [[Commander Fullore]].  A short cutscene will occur. {{Chat option|1 Let's get going.}}
* Once the cutscene is over, you will be south of a little house that you will need to investigate.
* Go in the house, go up the stairs, and search the drawers in the eastern room. Read the receipt.
* Go down the stairs and talk to [[Tomas Lawry]] by the roses {{Chat option|2}}.
* Go to the Lovakengj pub north-west of the Kourend Castle and speak to [[Fuggy]]. {{Chat option|3 Had any councillors stay here recently?}} 
* Go to Veos's boat in the south-eastern corner of Port Piscarilius and talk to [[Cabin Boy Herbert]] close to the quest and travel marker. {{Chat option|2 I'm looking for a councillor.}} A short cutscene will occur. 
** {{Colour|red|'''Warning:'''}} Combat will immediately follow the cutscene.
* After the cutscene you will need to defeat the level 168 demon [[Judge of Yama (A Kingdom Divided)|Judge of Yama]]. Dodge the fire waves like [[Galvek]] by standing away from the fire and running to the boss to melee him. He will have protect from magic & protect from missiles overhead during the entire fight.
** ''A good tactic is to use protect from melee and dodge the flames until you get in melee range. Tanking the flames to get into melee range is also a viable option.''
* After the boss has been killed a cutscene inside Kourend Castle will occur.
* Go south-west to speak to [[Commander Fullore]] outside of the castle after the cutscene. She will be standing just south of the castle, directly north of the Shayzien mine.
* Speak to [[Martin Holt]] again a bit east of Kourend Castle entrance where you started the quest.
* Head to the ground floor of the [[Arceuus Library]] and Right-click teleport on [[Archeio]].
* Pickpocket [[Istoria]] for a [[Bluish key]].
* Search the pink case in the south-east corner of the room to retrieve [[Rose's diary]].
* Go back and speak to Martin Holt again with Rose's Diary. A note will fall out of the diary. 
* Read the note and speak to Martin again.
}}
